description: This Python source file implements a class 'CloudZeroStreamer' responsible for batching and sending CBF data to the CloudZero AnyCost API. The module handles data grouping by date, timezone conversions, payload preparation, and API communication using httpx. It also manages error handling and logs progress via rich.console.

classes.name: CloudZeroStreamer
classes.description: A class responsible for streaming CBF data to CloudZero's API, including batching, timezone handling, and API communication.

methods.name: __init__(self, api_key: str, connection_id: str, user_timezone: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes the CloudZeroStreamer with API credentials, connection ID, and optional user timezone; sets default timezone to UTC if not provided or invalid.

methods.name: None send_batched(self, data: pl.DataFrame, operation: str = "replace_hourly")
methods.description: Accepts a Polars DataFrame and batches the data by date, then sends each batch to CloudZero API.

methods.name: dict[str,pl.DataFrame] _group_by_date(self, data: pl.DataFrame)
methods.description: Groups data rows by date after converting timestamps to UTC, returning a dictionary of date strings to DataFrames.

methods.name: datetime _parse_and_convert_timestamp(self, timestamp_str: str)
methods.description: Parses ISO 8601 timestamp strings and converts them to UTC datetime objects.

methods.name: None _send_daily_batch(self, batch_date: str, batch_data: pl.DataFrame, operation: str)
methods.description: Sends a single day's batch of data to the CloudZero API endpoint with proper headers and payload.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _prepare_batch_payload(self, batch_date: str, batch_data: pl.DataFrame, operation: str)
methods.description: Prepares the API payload from a batch DataFrame, including formatting and API-specific structure.

methods.name: Optional[dict[str,Any]] _convert_cbf_to_api_format(self, row: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a row from the DataFrame into CloudZero's expected API format, converting numeric types to strings and ensuring timestamps are UTC.

methods.name: str _ensure_utc_timestamp(self, timestamp_str: str)
methods.description: Ensures the timestamp string is in ISO format with UTC timezone ('Z').
